limitations: Checkpoint A source review only except the explicitly noted screenshot finding.
The initial browser discovery failed; later checkpoints used a current-source frontend and local Django backend.
Do not treat the proxy-origin 403 screenshot as a product failure.

findings.finding: Confirmation preferences initialize false, allowing actions to run without confirmation by default; confirm exact policy path before implementation.
Conflict warning reports only a count and does not identify the conflicting event or time.
A screenshot showed a raw 403 response and no recovery guidance; its run used the invalid local proxy Origin setup and is excluded as product evidence.
Notification deep link includes a run ID, but the Briefings page ignores it and only displays the latest 12 runs.
Preview gives a generic no-slot explanation instead of an actionable reason.
